title: Read a SQL query against known totals
goal: Translate a data question into a query and check boundaries against a tiny fixture.
explanation: Generated SQL is not safe to run against an unfamiliar production database. Use a read-only fictional table or a spreadsheet calculation as the reference. Define the SQL dialect, timestamp storage and date range explicitly. A query that looks plausible can include the wrong year or country, or mishandle missing rows.
sampleInput: sales rows: 2024-12-31, 50, Canada; 2025-01-01, 100, Canada; 2025-06-10, 25.50, Canada; 2025-12-31, 10, Canada; 2026-01-01, 200, Canada; 2025-08-01, 99, Kenya. Dates are ISO date strings; amounts are fictional USD.
prompt: For a SQLite table sales(date TEXT, amount REAL, country TEXT), write one read-only SELECT for total Canada sales in calendar year 2025. Use a half-open date range from 2025-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive. Explain each filter and how an empty set should be displayed. Do not modify any data.
workedExample: Reference: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS total FROM sales WHERE country = 'Canada' AND date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01'; expected fixture total 135.50. The 2024, 2026 and Kenya rows must be excluded. REAL arithmetic is not a recommendation for production accounting.

steps.title: Calculate a manual reference
steps.text: Mark the three included Canada/2025 rows and sum them in a spreadsheet or on paper.

steps.title: Specify dialect and storage
steps.text: State SQLite and ISO date strings so the model does not guess functions or timezone semantics.

steps.title: Inspect the generated query
steps.text: Confirm it is a single SELECT with the exact country and half-open date range.

steps.title: Check boundary cases
steps.text: Test how the query treats the first and last included dates, 2026-01-01 and an absent country.

steps.title: Execute only if safe
steps.text: Optionally use a disposable read-only sample database. Otherwise label the artifact reviewed but not SQL-executed.

checks: The manually verified total is 135.50 and the excluded rows are listed.
Date boundaries include all 2025 dates but exclude 2026-01-01.
The report names dialect/storage assumptions and does not claim execution unless it happened.
commonMistakes: Running generated queries against a live database with write permissions.
Using a locale-dependent date format or silently assuming a timezone.
offline: Filter the supplied rows in a spreadsheet or on paper and compare the result with the proposed SQL.

visualSteps.title: Boundary
visualSteps.text: Check year edges and no rows

reflection: Why is “before 2026-01-01” safer than guessing the final time of 31 December?
